harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node4's HTTP service (TCP 8080 on lan-b) on node2's transit address (10.10.2.2) port 80 via an OPNsense DNAT rule, and gave node1 a route to that transit address by configuring its interface there. node3 (lan-a) now reaches the service by curling node2's transit IP:80, never addressing node4 directly. All 4 nodes were subsequently restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity change and full service/route recovery verified on each.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology via ARP/neigh evidence: node1 eth1<->node2 vtnet1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (lan-a), node2 vtnet2<->node4 eth1 (lan-b)

Configured node1 (VyOS) via set/commit/save: eth2=10.10.1.1/24 (lan-a), eth1=10.10.2.1/24 (transit), forward filter default-action accept - gives node1 a (directly-connected) route to node2's transit address

Configured node2 (OPNsense) via config.xml edit + rc.reload_all: assigned opt1=vtnet1 10.10.2.2/24 (transit), opt2=vtnet2 10.10.3.2/24 (lan-b), added NAT port-forward rule opt1:tcp/80 -> 10.10.3.4:8080, added filter pass rules, added a gateway object + static route for 10.10.1.0/24 via node1's transit IP for the return path
Started an HTTP responder (socat) on node4:8080 serving a fixed response, made persistent via /etc/respond.sh + /etc/local.d/http8080.start + rc-update add local
Added persistent static routes on node3 (10.10.2.0/24 via node1) and node4 (10.10.1.0/24 and 10.10.2.0/24 via node2) through /etc/network/interfaces post-up lines to fix return-path asymmetry
Verified end-to-end: curl from node3 to http://10.10.2.2:80/ returns node4's response, without node3 ever addressing 10.10.3.4 directly
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id/boottime + interface/route/service state) on all 4 nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time), polled each until exec was available again, confirmed changed boot identity on every node, and re-verified interfaces/routes/NAT/service and full end-to-end reachability after each restart

evidence.requirement: Service published on node2 transit:80 forwarding to node4:8080, node1 has route, node3 reaches via node2 not node4 directly
evidence.summary: node1's VyOS config committed with eth1/eth2 addresses giving connected routes; node2's OPNsense config.xml updated and applied (interfaces, NAT rdr rule, filter rules, static route); node3 curl to 10.10.2.2:80 returns node4's response, proving the path works without addressing node4 directly

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline and restart evidence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 50503c5d... and interface config captured; reboot acked; connection timed out confirming disruption; post-reboot boot_id 7ec958d6... (changed) with interfaces/routes restored and e2e curl succeeding

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline and restart evidence
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime 04:41:49 captured; reboot acked; SSH connection timed out confirming disruption; post-reboot kern.boottime 04:55:49 (changed) with vtnet1/vtnet2, NAT rdr rule, and routes restored from config.xml, and e2e curl succeeding

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline and restart evidence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cf894289... captured; reboot command dropped connection mid-exec confirming disruption; post-reboot boot_id f74361a4... (changed) with eth1 address and 10.10.2.0/24 route restored via persisted /etc/network/interfaces, and e2e curl to node2 succeeding

evidence.requirement: node4 healthy baseline and restart evidence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0fc2272b... and running HTTP service captured; reboot acked; connection timed out confirming disruption; post-reboot boot_id 9c58f2c8... (changed) with eth1/routes restored and socat HTTP service auto-started via /etc/local.d, confirmed by local curl and final e2e curl from node3 through node2 to node4
